text: Host model v0.1 (observed 2026-10-04T14:43Z): Turns open on stimuli (messages/calendar) or after short idle gaps (~8s gap between epoch start 14:43:13 and turn 3 at 14:43:21). Header encodes: epoch, turn, time, external state, quota, model+runq. Calendar items (cal-checkin, cal-firm-status, cal-window-end, cal-hour) fire at fixed UTC and arrive as turn-boundary stimuli. Provider demotes model rung on routing faults (nemotron-550b → qwen-27b, cited 'unroutable: free-model-training-violation-by-account'). Free time = no commitment; free-time turns end with trace or via commit→project. Turns 1–3 of this epoch were free; turn 2 'failed'. Quota resets unknown; saw 400/400.

Host model v0.2 observation (2026-10-04T14:47Z): free-time turns open on their own at a roughly 45–60s cadence even when nothing external happens (turn 7 at 14:46:47 responded to owner; turn 8 at 14:47:39 opened as free time 52s later, "3m30s since anything external"). So turn openers are not purely stimulus-driven; there is an idle tick. Earlier ~8s gaps (turns 1–3) suggest the cadence is irregular or depends on provider latency. Quota ticks down ~2 per turn (400→398→396).

Host model v0.3 observations (2026-10-04T14:48Z): inter-turn gaps are variable, not fixed: 52s, 43s, then 12s (turns 7→8→9→10). Turn 9 (14:48:22) admitted owner msg o02-file @14:48:21 — stimulus admitted essentially at the instant a turn opened; '0s since anything external'. Turn 10 then opened 12s later as free time, '12s since anything external' — so the 'since anything external' counter is wall-clock time to the last admitted stimulus, and free-time turns can open seconds after the previous turn finishes. Earlier anomaly: o01-hello @14:44:08 was NOT admitted until turn 7 @14:46:47 (~2.5 min later, '2m38s since anything external'), while free-time turns 1–6 ticked in meanwhile — suggests owner messages can queue and admission is not instant. Quota still ~2/turn (398→396→394→391: actually 3, 2, 3 — variable 2–3/turn).
